themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Explores AI agents acting autonomously or semi-autonomously to conduct research, analyze data, or manage research workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that help developers write, review, debug, and secure code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers a broad range of AI-powered tools and platforms designed to assist researchers in various aspects of their work, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Examines how AI is integrated into design processes and research methodologies to enhance creativity, efficiency, and insights.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Delves into the use, impact, and implications of AI chatbots in various research contexts, including user interaction and data generation.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Investigates how AI is affecting jobs, skills, hiring, and the overall workforce, with a focus on research and development roles.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Covers AI applications that condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries for faster understanding.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Focuses on AI-generated or simulated user data, personas, or interactions used in research and testing.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Discusses the assessment, comparison, and best practices for utilizing various AI tools in research and design.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Explores the application of AI in streamlining and enhancing the process of usability testing for products and services.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
